what_this_is: PlotNua production switches (founder decision 1 Nov 2026, Idea Board launch, Option B). Changed only by a reviewed commit, so every switch has an author, a time and a reason in git history. Read by the Idea Board publishing workflow. plotnua_host ("pages" or "worker", hosting migration A5): which host serves plotnua.ie; "worker" turns on the push-triggered production deploy of the plotnua-site Worker and must be set together with workers_dev = false.
